_meta.description: Re-fit of the starter-hook-add-pitches override for the MLB manager_pitching='v2' model, made necessary by promoting log5/odds-ratio combination for hr_tgt/inplay_hit in sim_engine/pitch_model.py (2026-07-19) -- that change shifted the raw pitch-count bias curve enough that the prior fit (-11, from 2026-07-17 against the naive-average combiner) no longer lands near zero. Re-swept manually against the same 35-tune/11-holdout 2026-season backfill (seed 2026, 100 sims/game), grid [-12,-13,-14] under the new log5 combiner, calibration disabled to see the raw effect. See Syndicate/mlb_sim_accuracy_assessment_and_optimization_plan.md Phase 1 item #1 and the log5 combiner promotion note in pitch_model.py's _combined().
_meta.rationale: Clean, monotonic bracket: -12 -> holdout bias +0.73 (tune), -13 -> holdout bias +0.44 / essentially zero on tune (-0.02), -14 -> overshoots negative (tune -0.73). -13 lands closest to zero on both tune and holdout without overshooting, and is a materially better pitch-count fit than the prior -11 value ever achieved even under the old naive-average combiner (holdout bias was +1.35 at best).

previous_fit.context: Fit against the naive-average rate combiner (pre-log5). Grid [-14,-11,-8,-5,-2]. Superseded by this entry once log5 combination was promoted for hr/inplay_hit -- see description above.
